_meta.source: matchrpg-runs-v06-v07, every run on v0.6.x and v0.7.x, 2026-10-23 to 2026-11-10
_meta.privacy: aggregates only; any cell with fewer than 3 distinct players is null
_meta.story_definition: not endless and not a challenge

key_stages.unit: share of story runs reaching the stage (%), win rate = clears / attempts at that stage (%)
key_stages.note: e12 and e24 are elites, e36 the world boss. Player-weighted: each player's runs sum to weight 1.

every_encounter.unit: per global encounter 1-180: attempts, reach % of story runs, loss % (runs ending at that encounter / attempts)

loss_by_segment.unit: loss % per encounter attempt (mean over the encounters in the segment)

top_spikes.unit: encounters with the highest loss % (>= 30 attempts)

end_reasons.unit: story runs by how they ended
end_reasons.note: hp = 'Slain by X'; dark = 'Caught by the dark'; other = empty reason (retreat or blank)

top_killers_by_world.unit: HP deaths by killer within each world (top 4, cells >= 3 players)

attempts_to_first_clear.unit: story attempts at the stage up to and including the first clear, per player (dump window only)
attempts_to_first_clear.note: players with pre-v0.6 history may have cleared it before the dump; their first dump attempt then counts as 1

warning_time_by_ending.unit: seconds per story run with edge danger >= 0.5 / HP danger >= 0.5, by ending

by_world.unit: story runs ending in each world, % by ending

by_tier.unit: story runs by tier, % by ending

by_encounter_kind.unit: story runs that did not win, by kind of the encounter they ended at

depth_by_run_number.unit: story depth (m) by the player's lifetime run number (payload run_no, counts runs before v0.6 too)

depth_by_run_number_new_players.unit: story depth (m) by lifetime run number, only players seen from their first runs

runs_to_milestone.unit: lifetime run number at which a player first reached the milestone (players seen from their first runs)
runs_to_milestone.n: 11 players seen from their first runs, of 21

runs_to_milestone_lifetime.unit: lifetime run number (payload run_no) of the run that first pushed the lifetime deepest (data.stats.deepest) past the milestone
runs_to_milestone_lifetime.n: players whose crossing happened inside the dump window
runs_to_milestone_lifetime.note: W2 starts at 1333 m (6666/5); first win = deepest 6666 m

sessions.unit: sessions split at gaps > 30 min between run uploads
rows: session minutes (first run start to last run end)
seconds between runs inside a session (upload gap minus next run's seconds)
sessions.note: upload `at` is the run's end; the gap includes results screen, menus, town and Prepare

runs_per_player.unit: players by number of non-challenge runs
runs_per_player.note: runs inside the dump window only

churn_last_run.unit: each player's last run: depth (m), and how many players stopped in world 1
rows: last run > 3 days before dump end
last run <= 3 days before dump end

by_tier.unit: runs per tier; story depth (m); pace = moves / second (all runs not resumed); seconds per 1000 m (story runs past 300 m, not resumed)

tier_changes.unit: changes of tier between a player's consecutive runs

pace_by_run_number.unit: story pace (moves / s) and tier mix (% of runs) by run number

pace_gain_within_player.unit: median story moves/s of lifetime runs 21+ minus runs 1-5, per player seen from the start

scroll_at_fights.unit: median scroll position on the BASE..MAX scroll range (0-1) when an elite or boss fight starts

seconds_to_boss.unit: median run seconds when the world boss fight starts

depth_by_tier_and_start_level.unit: story depth (m) by tier inside start-level bands

by_depth_band.unit: medians per story run not resumed from a checkpoint, grouped by the depth (m) the run ended at
by_depth_band.note: low_hp / edge seconds count time with danger >= 0.5 (run_log DANGER_LINE); hesitation = a gap of 3 s or more between moves

per_world_in_run.unit: per world of a story run (data.worlds): seconds, moves/s, HP lost, traps

per_fight.unit: story elite and boss fights: seconds to kill, HP lost as % of arrival HP, arrival HP as % of run's end max HP, % of fights that ended the run
per_fight.n: story fights (data.fights holds elites and bosses only)

by_depth_band.unit: story runs: start level, end level and end stats by end depth band

depth_by_start_level.unit: story depth (m) by hero level at run start (meta-progression)

depth_by_town_upgrades.unit: story depth (m) by the sum of town building levels at run end

depth_by_talent_rows.unit: story depth (m) by talent rows picked (data.rows)

laps.unit: endless runs by the lap they ended in

endings.note: other = empty reason; in endless this is most often a retreat

killers.unit: endless HP deaths by killer (cells >= 3 players)

by_endless_run_number.unit: endless depth (m) by the player's endless run number

ending_by_depth.unit: endless runs by end depth (m), % by ending

story_by_version.unit: story runs by version; win % = clears / attempts at W1 elites and boss (>= 10 attempts)
story_by_version.n: versions with >= 30 story runs and >= 3 players, plus the two majors
story_by_version.note: versions differ in player mix and experience: compare with median_run_no

within_player_v06_to_v07.unit: median story depth (m) on v0.7 minus on v0.6, per player with >= 3 story runs on each

depth_by_window_and_start_level.unit: story depth (m) by version window inside start-level bands (controls for meta-progression)

top4_weight.unit: how much the 4 players with most runs weigh (%)

run_vs_player_weighted.n: 651 story runs, 18 players; without top 4: 308 runs, 14 players
run_vs_player_weighted.note: player_weighted = median of per-player medians, or shares with each player's runs summing to 1

resumed_runs.unit: runs resumed from a checkpoint after the page was killed (log covers the run from there)
